Sam (CEO): quick weekly update \u2014 three items. read and flag blockers.
Sam (CEO): 1) Policy change: hosted API default retention -> 90 days. Priya + Legal to finalise customer note by Fri COB.
Sam (CEO): 2) Private GA: internal rollout targeted next Wed; external pilot invites start the following week. product+eng confirm onboarding checklist by Mon EOD.
Sam (CEO): 3) Reliability: staging canary hit a memory leak in batching yesterday; rollback happened, no prod impact. SRE+eng to produce postmortem.
Priya - VP Product: ack. I'll draft the customer-facing message and FAQ; Hana please review legal phrasing.
Diego - Eng Lead: PR #5123 addresses batching leak; staging redeploy tomorrow AM. will add kv-cache healthchecks.
Morgan (SRE): incident brief: staging OOM at 02:10 UTC due to batch accumulation with long prefixes. Rolled back to v1.23.x. Postmortem Thu 15:00 UTC in #incidents. Runbook updated.
Hana (Legal): pref phrasing: "Default retention 90 days; extended retention available via contract." will post redlines Thu AM.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated by Morgan (SRE) at 02:10 UTC: "ROLLBACK_OK - MEM_PRESSURE_DETECTED"
Sam (CEO): two org asks: A) surface any GA blockers by Mon 09:00 PT. B) if you can't attend postmortem, add notes to doc beforehand.
Sam (CEO): thanks everyone ":thumbsup:"
__comments: Single-thread Slack conversation stored as one string; messages chronological; no title per agents.md.
